solution_overview:
This problem describes the subscription habits of households to two streaming services, X and Y. We are given the individual probabilities of subscribing to each service and the probability of subscribing to both. A single household is randomly selected, and we need to evaluate various probability statements regarding its subscription status.

Let $X$ be the event that a household subscribes to Streaming Service X, and $Y$ be the event that a household subscribes to Streaming Service Y. We are given the following probabilities:

$$P(X) = 0.55$$
$$P(Y) = 0.40$$
$$P(X \cap Y) = 0.25$$

To determine the probability that a household subscribes to at least one service, we use the Addition Rule for probabilities:

$$P(X \cup Y) = P(X) + P(Y) - P(X \cap Y)$$
$$P(X \cup Y) = 0.55 + 0.40 - 0.25$$
$$P(X \cup Y) = 0.70$$
This means the probability that a randomly selected household subscribes to at least one service is $0.70$, or $70\%$.

The probability that a household subscribes to neither service is the complement of subscribing to at least one service:

$$P(\text{neither}) = 1 - P(X \cup Y)$$
$$P(\text{neither}) = 1 - 0.70$$
$$P(\text{neither}) = 0.30$$
This means the probability that a randomly selected household subscribes to neither service is $0.30$, or $30\%$.

The probability that a household subscribes only to Service X is the probability of subscribing to X minus the probability of subscribing to both:

$$P(X \text{ only}) = P(X) - P(X \cap Y)$$
$$P(X \text{ only}) = 0.55 - 0.25$$
$$P(X \text{ only}) = 0.30$$
This means the probability that a randomly selected household subscribes only to Service X is $0.30$, or $30\%$.

Similarly, the probability that a household subscribes only to Service Y is the probability of subscribing to Y minus the probability of subscribing to both:

$$P(Y \text{ only}) = P(Y) - P(X \cap Y)$$
$$P(Y \text{ only}) = 0.40 - 0.25$$
$$P(Y \text{ only}) = 0.15$$
This means the probability that a randomly selected household subscribes only to Service Y is $0.15$, or $15\%$.

Finally, the probability that a household subscribes to exactly one service is the sum of the probabilities of subscribing to X only and Y only:

$$P(\text{exactly one}) = P(X \text{ only}) + P(Y \text{ only})$$
$$P(\text{exactly one}) = 0.30 + 0.15$$
$$P(\text{exactly one}) = 0.45$$
This means the probability that a randomly selected household subscribes to exactly one service is $0.45$, or $45\%$. These calculated probabilities will be used to evaluate the truthfulness of the given statements.
